name: WebSocket Gateway
description: Shared realtime transport: a standalone Socket.IO gateway process that hosts one namespace per domain. Provides handshake tickets, presence/markers, a Redis pub/sub bridge, and ns-auth — domains register a RealtimeNamespace via the `websocket:namespace` extension point.

extensionPoints.description: Domain modules contribute a RealtimeNamespace descriptor (default export) that the gateway wires onto its own Socket.IO namespace at boot.

author: Kuray Karaaslan
